description: Fiserv, Inc. is a leading global provider of payments and financial services technology solutions, publicly traded on the NASDAQ Global Select Market and part of the S&P 500 Index, serving clients around the globe including merchants, banks, credit unions, other financial institutions, and corporate and public sector clients. It helps clients achieve best-in-class results through a commitment to innovation and excellence in areas including account processing and digital banking solutions, card issuer processing and network services, payments, e-commerce, merchant acquiring and processing, and the Clover cloud-based point-of-sale and business management platform, and most of the products and services it provides are necessary for its clients to operate their businesses and are therefore non-discretionary in nature. It serves its global client base by working among its geographic teams across the United States of America and Canada, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Latin America, and Asia Pacific, and in 2025 it had $21.2 billion of revenue.
